propositions: Close gate does not enforce the requirement that a duplicate close must record a `duplicates` link before proceeding to the completion verifier, causing the LLM to fail with an unhelpful remediation message that omits the actual fix.
The gate should raise CommandError with an exact `rebar link <id> <canonical> duplicates` command when closing a bug as duplicate without a recorded replacement link, before any billable LLM call.
A recorded `duplicates` link whose target is closed should still satisfy the gate requirement and route to the disposition path, since link existence matters but target openness does not.
When a duplicate close names an archived or unresolvable target, the error message must distinguish the dead-target case from the no-link case.
The hard fail must be scoped to `duplicate` class only; `not_a_bug` and `escalated` must retain the prior fallthrough behavior unchanged.
